artifacts.description: Stress-tests assumptions and constructs failure scenarios for high-stakes or architecturally significant requirements. Spawned by sw-doc-review.
Adversarially verifies completed task-row claims against branch diff evidence. Spawned by verification-gate during /sw-ship and reused at deliver collect.
Reviews documents for internal consistency — contradictions, terminology drift, broken references. Spawned by sw-doc-review.
Reviews UI/UX flows, interaction design, and accessibility gaps. Spawned by sw-doc-review.
Maps a proposed spec to affected in-repo documentation artifacts and required updates. Spawned by sw-doc-review.
Evaluates whether proposed approaches will survive contact with reality — conflicts, dependency gaps, migration risks. Spawned by sw-doc-review.
Challenges premise claims and strategic consequences — what to build and why. Spawned by sw-doc-review.
Clean-context RCA hypothesis generator for one evidence partition (logs, diff, data, or config). Spawned by rca-core fan-out mode only.
Disproof-focused refuter for one RCA hypothesis before route decisions. Spawned after fan-out synthesis; never shares generator context.
Filters false positives from rule verifier output before human promotion. Spawned after sw-rule-verifier in retro compounding.
Tests a candidate behavioral rule against transcript and diff evidence before promotion. Spawned by retro compounding and rule verifier sweep.
Reviews scope alignment — unjustified complexity, scope creep, missing boundaries. Spawned by sw-doc-review.
Evaluates auth, data handling, API exposure, and trust-boundary risks in requirements. Spawned by sw-doc-review.
Develop one brainstorm divergence option in isolation for tournament selection. Spawned by tournament skill only.
Pairwise tournament judge scoring an explicit rubric between two isolated attempts. Spawned by tournament skill only.
Create a sibling amendment for a frozen PRD with continued R-IDs and supersede/retract directives. Does not edit the parent file.

Route a free-form question to the best-fit existing persona for a read-only consult. Does not draft, review, freeze, dispatch a pipeline command, or mutate any file, config, or planning-store artifact.

Research and crystallize a new consult persona into one fixed local destination with confirm-before-write. Does not overwrite an existing persona, does not run the doc-review panel, and does not copy proprietary text or assets.
Explore requirements through collaborative dialogue and write a brainstorm requirements doc. Does not draft a PRD or run the persona panel.
Override caveman communication intensity for the current chat until the next command dispatch. Does not load external skills or change artifact file fidelity.

Enumerate and remove merged branches, stale worktrees, and terminal deliver run-state with dry-run default and explicit confirm. Does not delete unmerged work, in-flight deliver runs, or use rm -rf on worktrees.
Commit the current phase after verify and review. Does not push or open a PR.
[DEPRECATED] Use /sw-retrospective instead. Thin alias for the internal compound write step only.
[DEPRECATED] Use /sw-retrospective instead. Thin alias routing to the consolidated retrospective orchestrator with phase auto-detect.
Signal-driven production debug — triages deploy/Sentry/user signals through shared RCA and routes a fix without implementing or merging.
Plan and run dependency-ordered deliver waves in phase-mode or multi-feature mode. Does not bypass /sw-ship, auto-merge to main, or re-author frozen task lists.
Orchestrate the doc pipeline through task freeze, then branch on doc.afterTasks before dispatching implementation. Does not inline implementation.
Review a PRD or decision-record draft with parallel persona sub-agents and apply safe fixes via synthesizer. Does not freeze artifacts or generate tasks.
Execute one phase-sized slice on the current branch using the spec union and per-task execute discipline. Does not commit, push, or open a PR.

Destination-first structured exploration before planning — idea, notebook, resume, promote, and explicit doc handoff. Does not create PRDs/tasks, dispatch implementation, or resolve Quick/Standard/Full tier at entry.
Unified inbound-signals intake — normalizes production, review, and retro feedback and routes to debug, gap-capture, or brainstorm without analyzing or authoring.
Close a routed feedback backlog signal after verification confirms the fix shipped. Human-gated; does not merge or dispatch routes.
Stamp frozen: true on an artifact, register in INDEX, and enforce immutability. Does not unfreeze or edit frozen parents.
Gap-check phase plan vs diff; bounded closers for in-scope gaps. Does not merge or ship alone.
Read-only diagnostic that explains sw- workflow behavior and checks current repo config/state/planning-backend reachability, citing relevant guides. Never mutates config, git, or the planning store.
Initialize and validate repo-local Shipwright config through a guided interview — scan, confirm, ask only unresolved choices — plus doctor/repair. Does not scaffold CI or migrate existing memories.
Read-only audit of a project's durable memories — flag mis-typed, mirrored, or low-signal entries and propose reclassification or collapse to pointer memories
Export durable memories to provider-neutral JSONL or OKF bundle for portability, backup, or a provider swap

Import durable memories into the active provider — from neutral JSONL/OKF (provider swap) or from repo knowledge (AGENTS.md learned sections + .project_docs pointers). Standing policy is rule-class SoT; AGENTS.md is pointer-only. Idempotent.
Distill new agent-transcript deltas into durable memories — the plugin-native replacement for the inherited continual-learning-index.json / agents-memory-updater flow
Bidirectional planning store migration between in-repo files and issue-store — dry-run by default; quiesce, doctor, and GAP-BACKLOG shim (PRD 044).

Capture a one-line idea, task, or note into the local notebook outside the planning store, with confirm-first graduation to a gap or brainstorm. Does not write to the planning store directly or replace /sw-feedback gap-capture.
Push the phase branch and create or update its PR against the recorded parent. Does not commit or merge.
Generate a PRD or decision-record draft (Full/Standard). Does not freeze, run persona review, or generate tasks.
Terminal readiness report — runs check-gate.py and never merges. Does not push or fix code.
Post-ship retrospective capturing learnings for compounding. Report-only; does not write memory or edit doctrine without approval.
Consolidated post-delivery retrospective (retro → compound write → memory-sync → status). Supports --pre-merge/--post-merge phase dispatch; does not merge or auto-promote rules.
Local-then-provider code review — phase 1 multi-agent (ce-code-review) then phase 2 external provider. Does not run the CI gate or stabilize PR threads.
Deprecated alias — delegates to /sw-init. Does not implement configuration logic.
Gated orchestrator over the phase loop — advances on green, halts at human merge gate. Never merges.
Behavior-preserving simplification and deslop pass on the uncommitted delta after review. Re-verifies via simplify-gate; does not commit, push, or merge.
Sync merge-base when the PR conflicts, then consume failing checks and unresolved threads before the next push. Does not merge the PR to main.
Start a child phase branch inside the current worktree and record parent context in per-worktree state. Does not push or open a PR.
Derive and reconcile PRD living status from git facts. Does not modify frozen PRDs or merge PRs.
Generate a frozen task list from a frozen PRD in a single pass. Does not start implementation.
Classify work into Quick, Standard, or Full tiers from deterministic signals. Does not run brainstorm, PRD, freeze, or implementation phases.
Run scoped local verification for the current phase; tee logs to /tmp. Does not fix code or commit.
Watch the active PR's checks under the all-checks gate and report the next action
Provision or tear down a per-work-item git worktree with env scaffold. Does not run the phase loop or merge PRs.

Explore requirements through one-question-at-a-time dialogue, then write a requirements document with stable R-IDs. Use when scope is open or Full-tier work precedes PRD drafting. Does not freeze artifacts or generate tasks.

Converge on an ambiguous preference through concrete either/or instances instead of re-asking the same abstract question. Use when brainstorm divergence is unsure, a doc-review disposition is disputed, or feedback scope classification is ambiguous. Does not resolve unrelated ambiguity or bypass human confirmation on the converged rule.

Evaluate CI check pass, fail, pending, and blocked state for a PR under Shipwright all-checks policy. Use when running /sw-watch-ci or /sw-stabilize to compute a single gate verdict. Honors neutral allowlist and review-provider state; does not merge.

Internal compound-write step for /sw-retrospective — distill retro and feedback into typed memories via memory-preflight. Use when compounding session learnings after retrospective. Human-gated rule promotion only; does not auto-promote rules.

Shared autonomous orchestration contract for self-continuation, legitimate halts, parallel phase dispatch, and durable-state resumption. Use when running /sw-deliver, /sw-ship, /sw-doc, /sw-debug, or /sw-feedback orchestrators. Does not re-author loop logic inline.
Signal-driven production debugging via shared RCA core. Use when triaging production errors, crashes, or regressions before fixing. Diagnoses and routes; does not implement patches or merge.

Dependency-ordered deliver waves with dependent-branch stacking and integration branch lifecycle. Use when shipping frozen task-list phases or multi-feature integration waves. Does not merge to main or bypass the merge gate.

Review PRD drafts with parallel persona sub-agents and a synthesizer that auto-applies safe fixes. Use when Standard or Full tier needs persona panel review before freeze. Quick tier skips; does not generate tasks.
Per-task TDD gate, two-stage subagent review, and executable-plan self-review for /sw-execute. Use when implementing frozen task phases with R-ID traceability. Does not ship or merge.

Destination-first structured exploration through ask → decide → confirm — humans own intent, blocking policy, promote, and doc handoff. Use when scope is unclear before /sw-doc. Does not dispatch implementation or create PRDs/tasks.
Unified inbound-signals intake and router. Use when normalizing Sentry, user, or CI feedback for /sw-debug or gap capture. Normalizes and dispatches; does not analyze, author, or execute fixes.
Consume GAP-BACKLOG into the implementation loop and close routed signals after verification. Use when confirming a fix shipped for a tracked feedback signal. Human-gated; does not merge PRs.
Compare phase plan (spec union + task checklist) against git diff with bounded closers. Use when /sw-ship needs in-scope gap detection before commit. Default-on; does not author new scope.

Shipwright trunk-based git conventions — branch names, Conventional Commits, PR and merge bodies, docs-on-a-branch. Use when creating branches, commits, or PRs in Shipwright worktrees. Host-agnostic; does not merge.

Derive PRD status from git and deliver state; reconcile planning INDEX, COMPLETION-LOG, and gap projections. Use when auditing planning drift or updating living status during deliver. Hard-blocks on drift; does not author docs.

Provider-agnostic durable-memory access for the Shipwright workflow. Use when loading context at phase start or storing distilled memories at phase end via /sw-memory-sync. Routes through configured provider; never calls providers directly.

Bounded parallel worktrees (~2–4 ceiling), cross-branch recombination, merge pre-flight, shared-migration refusal. Use when /sw-deliver or /sw-worktree fans out independent heads. Does not bypass merge gates.

Generate a PRD or decision-record draft for Full or Standard tier. Use when requirements are brainstormed and a written spec is needed before persona review. Does not freeze, run doc-review, or generate tasks.
Shared hypothesis-driven root cause analysis core for stabilize, debug, and dev-time entry points. Use when forming or refuting RCA hypotheses before routing fixes. Does not patch code or merge.

Post-ship retrospective — what went well, painful, and should change; learning candidates for compounding. Use when running /sw-retrospective after phase or merge milestones. Report-only by default; does not auto-apply rules.
Phase ship loop gates for /sw-ship — dist freshness, build-chain parity, operator-local closeout hygiene. Use when executing or resuming the ship chain. Does not merge.
Per-worktree Shipwright state read and write contract. Use when resuming /sw-ship phases or reading runDir and phase status across worktrees. Resolves gitdir state; does not merge branches.

Behavior-preserving cleanup pass (reuse, quality, efficiency, AI-slop removal) after review. Use when /sw-ship runs post-review deslop before gap-check. Re-verified via simplify-gate; does not skip verify.

Pre-freeze spec quality gates (clarify, checklist, analyze) and R-ID to task to test traceability. Use when validating PRD quality before /sw-freeze on Standard or Full tier. Blocks freeze on hard failures.

Resolve a frozen PRD or decision record plus amendments into one effective spec. Use when executing or reviewing against the authoritative requirement set. Read-only on parent; does not author amendments.

Opt-in goal-driven loop that keeps running /sw-stabilize and /sw-watch-ci until the all-checks gate is green and no actionable review threads remain. Use when the user asks to stabilize until green or from /ship. Single-pass /sw-stabilize remains default; does not merge.

Generate a frozen task list from a frozen PRD using the spec union in one pass. Use when PRD is frozen and implementation tasks are needed before /sw-freeze. No mid-pass user gates; does not implement.

Run a bounded N-attempt tournament with deterministic bracketing and pairwise judges. Use when brainstorm divergence selection needs an isolated winner among competing options. Does not auto-apply decisions or bypass human synthesis.
Classify work into Quick, Standard, or Full tiers from deterministic signals. Use when routing new work or re-scoring scope mid-flight. Does not run the doc pipeline or implementation phases.

Evidence-over-claims gate emitting verified, not-verified, or inconclusive from structured status files. Use when /sw-ship needs local evidence before commit. Complementary to checks-gate; never overrides CI truth.

Provision per-work-item git worktrees with env scaffold (ports, DB strategy) and safe teardown. Use when starting isolated implementation or docs work under the parallelism ceiling. Enforces ceiling; does not merge.
